description: Added mean and standard deviation for each model. which fixes simswap 256 color issue.

comments.body:
Change all entries to this, no trailing comma too
```
	'size': (128, 128),
	'mean': [ 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 ],
	'deviation': [ 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 ]
```

Change code to this, no need for passing via method.
```
model_mean = get_options('model').get('mean')
model_deviation = get_options('model').get('deviation')
crop_frame = (crop_frame - model_mean) / model_deviation
```
